caption: Each fragment carries its own copy of the 20-byte header, so total length = 20 + data. The offset counts 8-byte units (1480 ÷ 8 = 185), and only the last fragment has MF = 0.

spec.title: Fragments for MTU 1500
spec.aria: A 3980-byte payload is cut into three fragments of 1480, 1480 and 1020 data bytes; each adds a 20-byte header giving total lengths 1500, 1500 and 1040 bytes, with offsets 0, 185 and 370 in 8-byte units and MF flags 1, 1 and 0.
